data.one_liner: Extensible collection of media viewers for preview and interactive experiences.
data.what_it_does: Provides an opinionated framework for media previews and interactions. It handles various media files like images, audio, video, and PDFs using unified MediaProviders and widgets.
use_when: You need to display preview and interactive media viewers for images, videos, audio, and PDFs.
You want an extensible media viewing framework with built-in Hero animation support.
avoid_when: You only need a simple audio player or a standalone video player without preview wrappers.
strengths: Supports multiple media types (image, audio, PDF, video) under a unified provider abstraction.
Provides both preview and interactive near-fullscreen widgets with Hero animations.
weaknesses: Opinionated structure may not fit custom bespoke media UI requirements.
Depends on several underlying media packages which may increase app size.
data.setup_notes: For video setup, follow the instructions on the video_player package.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust, feature-rich audio player without the broader mixed-media viewer framework.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need core video playback capabilities without extra preview widgets.
